prerequisites: Manufacturing methods (turning, milling, drilling... cutting tools, cutting parameters, tooling)

learning_outcomes.text: Design manufacturing process plans for complex parts, ensuring both technical feasibility (tool accessibility, machine rigidity) and economic performance (material cost, productivity).

syllabus_topics: CAD Models of Non-Developable Surfaces (Bézier, B-splines, NURBS)
CAD Techniques for Non-Developable Surfaces (CATIA V5 - Shape Generator, Repair Assistant, Connect Checker, G2/G3 continuity, Mesh Optimization)
Machining Strategies (3 to 5 Axis - Z-Level, 5-Axis Contour Milling)
5-Axis CAM Techniques (CATIA V5 Workflow: Machine Axis Definition, Toolpath Calculation with Free Contouring and Automatic Collision Avoidance, Post-Processing)
Critical Case: Machining Inconel turbines with integrated thermal compensation
Case Study: "Project" Part (Turbine Blade - NURBS modeling, Swarf Machining, Tolerance analysis verification)
Surface CAM Project (Pedagogical Mock-Up: 3-Axis Phase with Z-Level Roughing and Profile cutting; 5-Axis Phase with Multi-Axis Pocket and Cutting force simulation via Abaqus)
Deliverables: Comparative time/quality report between methods, Reusable CATIA tool library (ball nose, toroidal cutters)
bibliography: Modélisation et construction de surface pour la CFAO, Jean-Claude LEON, Bibliothèque ENIT 516.3 LEO.
B-splines, R.H. BARTELS, Bibliothèque ENIT 516.3 BAR.
L'utilisation des courbes et surfaces en CAO, Pierre Bézier, Bibliothèque ENIT 516.3 BEZ.
Fabrication assistée par ordinateur, Alain BERNARD, Lavoisier, 2003.
L'usinage 5 axes, Eric GALLET et Christophe DESPLATZ, Publications CETIM, 2004.
